title: Trying to optimize Sword Bard Build help needed.
author: egonunkafasi
body:
Hello there,

While trying to optimize build i stumbled upon 3 choices. Gonna play melee sword bard. Used an item hence is spoiler tagged. There is another version of that type of weapon it can also be considered.

Option A:

Dex based Half Orc - 1 Sorcerer / 11 Sword Bard

Fighting Style: Dueling (+2 damage)

Weapon: PHALAR ALUVE (Shriek +1-4 damage) -1 action

Shield so bonus AC +2 -

Must Feat: Moderately Armoured

Going just for half orc for crits. Since there is bonus action from offhand it can also can use bonus action spells etc.  It can use shield in lvl 5 but since thee weapon is found around lvl 5 doesnt matter.

Option B:

Dex Based  Wood High Elf - 1 Sorc / 11 Sword Bard

Fighting Style: Dueling (+2 damage)

Weapon: PHALAR ALUVE (Shriek +1-4 damage) -1 action

Shield so bonus AC +2

Must Feat: None hence Dex can be higher (+2) so better weapon scaling +  Since there is bonus action from offhand it can also can use bonus action spells etc. It can use shield much earlier than option A but it loses the crit damage chance.

Option C:

Dex based X -  1 Sorc / 11 Sword Bard

Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting (+X)

Just dual wield 2 finesse melee

Must Feat: None Usual used build hence there is explanation needed

I know there is lot to consider and gaps since didn't wrote the stats but in  experienced builders and theorycrafters can probably can fill these. Btw if you have better melee based sword bard suggestion I would like to hear it, in both class  distribution , or race, feat etc. ( Melee Sword Bard is must )

I was trying to give general idea of the builds. Will add more details when I have a time and chance.
